• RAINBOW CHIP FROSTING: The colorful chips are in the delicious frosting; Goes great with baked goods such as cakes, cupcakes, and cookies
  • QUICK AND EASY: Just pop open the can, spread the frosting, and enjoy
  • A TRUSTED FAVORITE: This Betty Crocker frosting is the perfect base for sprinkles and other fun decorations; Try our frosting with other trusted favorites such as Betty Crocker Cake Mix or Brownie Mix
  • GLUTEN FREE: This gluten free frosting is an ideal pantry staple; Keep this Betty Crocker frosting on hand with baking supplies for your impromptu baking needs
  • CONTAINS: One 16 oz tub of Betty Crocker Original Rainbow Chip Frosting
features: Betty Crocker’s Original Rainbow Chip Frosting is a creamy, gluten‑free treat, artfully dotted with soft, colorful chips that instantly brighten cakes, cupcakes, and cookies. Just pop open the 16‑ounce tub and spread—it’s quick, convenient, and perfect for spontaneous celebrations. Its rich, sweet flavor and smooth texture have earned praise from both gluten‑free consumers and traditional eaters alike . Free from gluten but inclusive of trusted ingredients like milk and soy, this frosting offers both indulgence and dietary peace of mind . Ideal for last‑minute baking, it maintains the beloved taste of classic Betty Crocker frostings, yet adds a fun, colorful twist with its embedded rainbow chips .
ingredients: Sugar, High Fructose Corn Syrup, Vegetable Oil (palm, coconut), Corn Starch, Water, Corn Syrup. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Monoglycerides, Nonfat Milk, Polysorbate 60, Whey, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate, Color (yellow lakes 5 & 6, blue lakes 1 & 2, red 40 lake, yellows 5 & 6), Natural and Artificial Flavor, Shellac, Soy Lecithin, Citric Acid. Freshness Preserved by Potassium Sorbate.
